description: Changes one booking: customer details, or start (and resource) to move it. A class time's class_id (cl_…, get_lists bookings classes) as item_id: start moves the whole class, waitlist "closed"/"open" closes or re-opens its waitlist. A move, or a change that emails someone, is two steps: the first call returns confirm_token. force books a clash anyway.

answers.description: {question id: answer} for the settings' questions ("" removes one)

confirm_token.description: From the first call, after the user's yes

notify_customer.description: Email the customer (default true when there is an email)

resource.description: With start: staff or room id or name

start.description: A new time: local "2026-10-15T14:00" (booking time zone)

waitlist.description: A class time (cl_…) or wl_ entry: close its waitlist (bookings stay; the people waiting are emailed) or re-open it

name: edit_booking
title: Change a booking
